text: The gate's own tests run on copies of the example projects, in `internal/verify/testdata/examples`, not on the examples themselves. The tests plant bugs by changing a line of an example's model or code, and the factory rebuilds the examples through pull requests whose CI skips the gate's tests (D-0079). The rebuilds of the Python two-phase commits on #59 and #60 changed the lines three tests planted in, and main's tests failed unseen until #62 ran them. The Go explorers' rebuilds would do the same to more. Each copy keeps its `.invariant` folder as `_invariant`, so CI, the dashboard and the scope check don't take it for a project, and the tests name it back.
